applicability: Frozen domestic Tax Invoice profile with VAT category S, one rate, SAR, and no allowances/charges/prepayments/rounding adjustment.

name: Standard VAT and document-total reconciliation
retrieval_text:
Rule: MVP-VAT-TOTAL-001 — Standard VAT and document-total reconciliation
Official identifiers: BR-S-08, BR-S-09, BR-CO-13, BR-CO-14, BR-CO-15, BR-CO-17, BT-109, BT-110, BT-112, BT-116, BT-117, BT-119
Meaning: For standard-rated lines, the VAT-category taxable amount reconciles to the applicable net amounts; category VAT equals taxable amount times rate divided by 100 rounded to two decimals; total VAT is the sum of category VAT; VAT-inclusive total equals VAT-exclusive total plus total VAT.
Applies to: Frozen domestic Tax Invoice profile with VAT category S, one rate, SAR, and no allowances/charges/prepayments/rounding adjustment.
Evidence locations: Electronic Invoice XML Implementation Standard | 10 Rounding; 13.2.2 BR-CO-13 through BR-CO-17; 13.2.3 BR-S-08 and BR-S-09 | 29–30 and 38–40 (PDF pages 30–31 and 39–41); Electronic Invoice Data Dictionary | Rows BT-109, BT-110, BT-112, BT-116, BT-117, and BT-119 | no page
Valid example: Taxable SAR 100.00 at 15.00% gives VAT 15.00 and tax-inclusive total 115.00.
Invalid example: Taxable SAR 100.00 at 15.00% declares VAT 14.00 or tax-inclusive total 114.00.

sources.section: 10 Rounding; 13.2.2 BR-CO-13 through BR-CO-17; 13.2.3 BR-S-08 and BR-S-09
sources.title: Electronic Invoice XML Implementation Standard

validation_logic: Use Decimal arithmetic and ROUND_HALF_UP to two decimal places for the category tax calculation. Under the frozen profile: BT-109 = BT-106; BT-117 = round(BT-116 × BT-119 / 100, 2); BT-110 = sum(BT-117); BT-112 = BT-109 + BT-110. Reject missing components before arithmetic.

applicability: All electronic invoice XML documents; exercised only on the frozen Tax Invoice profile.
meaning: The invoice XML must be well formed, follow the UBL 2.1 element sequence, contain UBL-mandatory elements, and use values compatible with element types.
name: XML well-formedness and UBL schema validity
retrieval_text:
Rule: MVP-XML-001 — XML well-formedness and UBL schema validity
Official identifiers: UBL 2.1 schema validation
Meaning: The invoice XML must be well formed, follow the UBL 2.1 element sequence, contain UBL-mandatory elements, and use values compatible with element types.
Applies to: All electronic invoice XML documents; exercised only on the frozen Tax Invoice profile.
Evidence locations: Electronic Invoice XML Implementation Standard | 4 Validation | 5–6 (PDF pages 6–7)
Valid example: A well-formed Invoice whose elements follow the UBL 2.1 sequence and XSD types.
Invalid example: An Invoice with an unclosed tag or cbc:ID in an invalid schema position.
validation_logic: Parse with a secure XML parser, then validate against the official UBL 2.1 Invoice XSD set packaged from the official SDK/reference materials. Fail closed when the schema bundle is unavailable or its recorded checksum differs.
